title: Configuration
description: The user file ($XDG_CONFIG_HOME/askboard/config.json, else $HOME/.config/askboard/config.json) and the project file (.askboard/config.json under the session project root) share this schema (AD-14). Every key is optional and its value closed. A key this minor does not define passes, so a session on an older minor reads a newer file, and the reader warns on it (settings-languages open question B2). A file that fails this schema applies no key at all.

version.description: The configuration version, as major.minor. A reader supports major 1 and accepts any of its minors; a file of another major applies no key (AD-14).

theme.description: A presentation key, which a board may write: system follows the system's colour scheme.

density.description: A presentation key, which a board may write.

contextPlacement.description: A presentation key, which a board may write: where a question's context shows by default.

defaultLanguage.description: The language of an ask that names none (FR-34).

askingRule.description: Which AskUserQuestion calls AskBoard takes instead (AD-16, FR-30).

snapshotFolder.description: Where Snapshots are written, relative to the session project root; ask-core replaces a path that leaves the project (AD-14).

editor.description: The command "Open in editor" runs, as an argument vector: the program, then its arguments, with {file} and {line} its only placeholders (AD-8). Read from the user file only.

defaultMinimumMargin.description: The sales molecule's default minimum margin, a percentage (settings-languages open question B14).
